# OpenGameArt Seamless Pattern Pack

- Upload: https://opengameart.org/content/seamless-pattern-pack
- Uploader/credited creator: n4. Upload dated 2012-01-21.
- License: CC0 1.0; the asset page records CC0 and states attribution is optional. Commercial use, modification, and redistribution permitted. License evidence bundled in CC0-1.0-LEGALCODE.txt.
- 51 selected originals across timber/planks, stone/gravel, masonry, paper/carton, textiles/denim, ice/snow, sand/beach, grass/greenery, and space/sky. Cultural or ambiguous themed material and duplicate resolutions were excluded.
- Original files retained under source/. For compact browser preview and Studio insertion, source pixels are transcoded to WebP at quality 90 and embedded in SVG wrappers; texture appearance is preserved for the reusable backgrounds.
